title: Case 003: Offer Awaiting the Owner
initial_request: Could you check on the property-insurance terms for 103 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 3ZZ and let me know when there is an offer for me to review?
overview: Florence asked Dan at Bracken Cover for an update on insurance terms for her property. Northmere Mutual sent Dan an offer showing a premium of £486 for 12 months of proposed cover and requesting a response within 21 days. Dan noted that the terms needed to be passed to Florence, then emailed them to her. Florence confirmed receipt and said she would review them; she did not make a purchase decision.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, Dan should pass Northmere Mutual's offer terms to Florence for review without suggesting that she has accepted them.

outcome: Florence confirmed receipt of the offer and said she would review it; she has not decided to buy.

events.body: Could you check on the insurance terms for 103 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 3ZZ? I have not seen an offer yet and would like to review it when it is available.
For 103 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 3ZZ, our offer is £486 for 12 months of proposed cover. Please provide your response within 21 days; these are offer terms, not confirmation that cover has started.
Northmere Mutual has sent its offer for Florence's property, and she has not yet seen the terms. I need to pass the insurer's terms to her for review without implying that she has agreed to buy.

Northmere Mutual has provided offer terms for 103 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 3ZZ: £486 for 12 months of proposed cover, with a response requested within 21 days. These are the insurer's terms for you to consider; I am not recording any decision to proceed on your behalf.
Thanks, I confirm I have received the offer terms. I will review them and let you know if I decide to proceed.
